Felton was a name of respect and signified a sense of belonging to a community. Today, it continues to be a name with a rich cultural heritage, reflecting the historical and geographical roots of the Anglo-Saxon and Norman peoples.

Moreover, the term "tun" refers to an enclosed or protected space, possibly representing the spiritual idea of seeking refuge and sanctuary in the presence and care of God. Ultimately, the name Felton may be seen as an invitation to trust in God and seek comfort and protection in the loving embrace of the Divine.
